headline: As of 2026-10-30: 49,205,046 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+9.4 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 49,205,046 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+9.4 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (6,921,719), California (5,094,898), Florida (4,511,313).
